text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation. No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA (LED modules on PCB, housing marking area)
test_case: Visual inspection of production samples of the ESA-approved rear lamp: verify that an approval mark conforming to paragraph 5.3 is present on each unit. Pass if the mark is present on every unit, or if the lamp is built into a vehicle approved as a unit and no marking is required.

text: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
applies_to: Vehicle approval marking (vehicle on which the rear combination lamp is installed)
test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle against the approval communication form: the mark is present at the specified place, is conspicuous and is easily accessible.

text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
applies_to: Vehicle approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the mark: a circle containing the letter "E" is followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country, which matches Annex 3 of R.E.3.

text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
applies_to: Vehicle approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the mark: "10R-" followed by the approval number appears to the right of the circle and matches the approval communication.

text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, connector/driver component, vehicle wiring connection) as an ESA fitted to the vehicle
test_case: Review design and installation documentation. Then run the UN R10 vehicle and ESA tests in normal conditions of use with all lamp functions operating. Pass if all R10 emission limits and immunity criteria are met.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated emissions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB and driver/connector)
test_case: Measure ESA radiated emissions per the R10 ESA radiated emission method (Annex 7 broadband / Annex 8 narrowband) with the lamp functions energised. Pass if emissions stay within the R10 ESA limits.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for conducted emissions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, vehicle wiring connection)
test_case: Measure conducted emissions on the supply lines per the R10 ESA conducted emission annexes (transient and RF emissions), with the lamp functions operating. Pass if emissions are within the specified limits.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB and driver/connector)
test_case: Apply radiated RF disturbance per the R10 ESA immunity method (Annex 9) to the energised lamp. Pass if the rear position, stop and reversing functions show no degradation of performance at the required field strength.

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to conducted disturbances.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply/wiring connection, LED driver on PCB)
test_case: Apply conducted transient disturbances on the supply lines per the R10 ESA conducted immunity annex (ISO 7637-2 pulses). Pass if the lamp functions meet the required functional status classes.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement performed on the ESA representative of its type; pass if the measurement follows the Annex 7 method.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 30-75 MHz; pass if the emission is below the limit line falling logarithmically from 62 to 52 dBµV/m.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 75-400 MHz; pass if the emission is below the limit line rising logarithmically from 52 to 63 dBµV/m (Appendix 6).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 broadband radiated emission measurement, 400-1,000 MHz; pass if the emission is below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement results across 30-1,000 MHz with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if all values are below the limits.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband radiated emission measurement on the representative ESA sample; pass if the test is performed per Annex 8 set-up and procedure.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan 30-75 MHz; pass if measured level is below the limit line decreasing logarithmically from 52 to 42 dB µV/m (Appendix 7).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan 75-400 MHz; pass if measured level is below the limit line increasing logarithmically from 42 to 53 dB µV/m (Appendix 7).

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 narrowband emission scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if measured level is below 53 dB µV/m throughout the band.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver electronics (ESA)
test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband results across 30-1,000 MHz with the 6.6.2.1 limits; pass if all measured values are below the limits.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances of the ESA representative of its type on 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp as ESA (LED modules on PCB, driver/connector components, supply line connection)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission test on the supply lines of the representative lamp sample; pass if the test is performed per ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 and the measured pulses are evaluated against the Table 1 levels.

text: When tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12 V supply lines shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp as ESA on 12 V supply lines (LED driver electronics, PCB, wiring connection)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement on 12 V supply line during switching of each lamp function (position, stop, reversing); pass if the positive pulse amplitude does not exceed +75 V.

text: When tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12 V supply lines shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp as ESA on 12 V supply lines (LED driver electronics, PCB, wiring connection)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement on 12 V supply line during switching of each lamp function; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -100 V in magnitude.

text: When tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 24 V supply lines shall be +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp as ESA on 24 V supply lines (LED driver electronics, PCB, wiring connection)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement on 24 V supply line during switching of each lamp function; pass if the positive pulse amplitude does not exceed +150 V.

text: When tested according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 24 V supply lines shall be -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
applies_to: Complete rear combination lamp as ESA on 24 V supply lines (LED driver electronics, PCB, wiring connection)
test_case: Annex 10 / ISO 7637-2 transient emission measurement on 24 V supply line during switching of each lamp function; pass if the negative pulse amplitude does not exceed -450 V in magnitude.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver/connector electronics)
test_case: Review the test plan and report: the immunity test method(s) are selected from Annex 9 (stripline, TEM cell, BCI, ALSE or reverberation chamber). Pass if the selected method(s) are Annex 9 methods applied to a representative sample.

text: When tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 stripline test, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test, 20 to 200 MHz at 75 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the BCI method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA wiring harness and electronics
test_case: Annex 9 bulk current injection, 20 to 400 MHz at 60 mA. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 30 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 80 to 2,000 MHz at 30 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 10 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 10 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 21 V/m in over 90 per cent of the LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, LUF to 2,000 MHz at 21 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the ESA shall be subjected to a test level of 7 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range (Table 2a).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test, 2,000 to 6,000 MHz at 7 V/m. Pass if the level is applied over >90 % of the band with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: When tested by the stripline method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range shall be 50 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 stripline test: verify that the applied level is >= 50 V/m at every frequency in 20 to 400 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the TEM cell method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency range shall be 62,5 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 TEM cell test: verify that the applied level is >= 62,5 V/m at every frequency in 20 to 200 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the BCI method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency range shall be 50 mA (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA wiring harness and electronics
test_case: Annex 9 BCI test: verify that the injected current is >= 50 mA at every frequency in 20 to 400 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency range shall be 25 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test: verify that the applied level is >= 25 V/m at every frequency in 80 to 2,000 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the ALSE method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range shall be 8 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 ALSE test: verify that the applied level is >= 8 V/m at every frequency in 2,000 to 6,000 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency range shall be 18 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test: verify that the applied level is >= 18 V/m at every frequency from LUF to 2,000 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: When tested by the reverberation chamber method as described in Annex 9, the minimum test level over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency range shall be 6 V/m (Table 2b).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Annex 9 reverberation chamber test: verify that the applied level is >= 6 V/m at every frequency in 2,000 to 6,000 MHz and that no degradation of immunity related functions occurs.

text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the ESA representative of its type.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions (LED modules, PCB, driver electronics)
test_case: Monitor the rear position, stop and reversing lamp outputs during all Annex 9 exposures (no unintended switching on or off, flicker or intensity change affecting the signal). Pass if no degradation of immunity related functions is observed.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, driver electronics, supply connection)
test_case: Annex 10 conducted transient immunity test on 12/24 V supply lines per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at Table 3a/3b levels; pass if the functional status/FPSC of Tables 3a and 3b is met.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (all lamp functions)
test_case: Starting profile test per ISO 16750-2/Annex 10; evaluate the lamp functions using the ISO 16750-1 functional status classification; pass if the Table 3a status is met.

text: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (all lamp functions)
test_case: Pulse tests per ISO 7637-2/Annex 10; classify lamp behaviour using the ISO 7637-1 FPSC; pass if the Table 3b FPSC is met.

text: For ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the ESA shall withstand the starting profile at immunity test level II for 12 V and 24 V systems with 10 pulses, meeting functional status B for ESA related to immunity related functions which shall be operational during engine start phases, C for other ESA related to immunity related functions, and D for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile, level II, 10 pulses on 12 V (or 24 V) supply per Annex 10; pass if functional status B (operational during engine start) or C (other), or D for non-immunity-related functions, per ISO 16750-1.

text: For test pulse 1, the ESA shall be tested at -75 V for 12 V systems and -450 V for 24 V systems with 500 pulses, and shall meet FPSC III for both functions related and not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply input, LED driver)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 1, -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses per Annex 10; pass if FPSC III per ISO 7637-1.

text: For test pulse 2a, the ESA shall be tested at +37 V for 12 V and 24 V systems with 500 pulses, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply input, LED driver)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a, +37 V, 500 pulses per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (not related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: For test pulse 2b, the ESA shall be tested at +10 V for 12 V systems and +20 V for 24 V systems with 10 pulses, and shall meet FPSC II for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply input, LED driver)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b, +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses per Annex 10; pass if FPSC II (immunity related functions) / III (not related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: For test pulse 3a, the ESA shall be tested at -112 V for 12 V systems and -150 V for 24 V systems for a test duration of 1 h, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply input, LED driver)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a, -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V), 1 h per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (not related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: For test pulse 3b, the ESA shall be tested at +75 V for 12 V systems and +150 V for 24 V systems for a test duration of 1 h, and shall meet FPSC I for functions related to immunity related functions and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (supply input, LED driver)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b, +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V), 1 h per Annex 10; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (not related) per ISO 7637-1.

text: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, driver component)
test_case: Design review of PCB schematic and BOM: confirm whether any oscillator or switching regulator operates above 9 kHz. If none is present, record deemed compliance with 6.3.2/6.6.2 and Annexes 5 and 8. Otherwise, perform radiated emission tests per Annexes 7 and 8.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (stop, rear position and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Functional analysis: determine whether the lamp functions (e.g. stop lamp, rear position lamp) are immunity related functions. If they are, perform the Annex 9 radiated immunity test. Exemption is valid only if it is documented that no immunity related function exists.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission on 12/24 V supply lines and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA power supply (LED PCB, vehicle wiring connection)
test_case: Design review of the circuit for internal switches and inductive loads (e.g. switching driver inductors). If none is present, record deemed compliance with 6.7. Otherwise, perform the transient conducted emission test per Annex 10 against the 6.7 limits.

text: The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements of paragraph 9.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronic sub-assembly (LED modules on PCB) as type-approved under UN R10, in series production
test_case: Audit of production control: check that the conformity of production procedures follow Schedule 1 of E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3 and the requirements of paragraph 9. Pass if the series-produced lamps are shown to conform to the approved type.

text: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7. above.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector/driver electronics) in series production
test_case: Conformity of production check: sample production rear lamps and repeat the paragraph 6 EMC tests (radiated broadband/narrowband emissions per Annexes 7/8, immunity) and paragraph 7 tests if applicable; pass if results meet the approved type's limits within the CoP statistical criteria.

text: Conformity of production of the vehicle or component or separate technical unit shall be checked on the basis of the data contained in the communication form(s) for type approval set out in Annex 3A and/or 3B to this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (LED modules on PCB, connector/driver components, wiring connection)
test_case: Conformity of production check: compare production samples of the rear combination lamp against the data recorded in the type approval communication form(s) of Annex 3A and/or 3B, repeating the EMC tests where required. Pass if the production lamps match the approved data and meet the type-approval limits.

text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA (LED modules on PCB, driver electronics) – series production conformity for radiated broadband and narrowband emissions
test_case: Conformity of production check on a series-produced lamp ESA: measure broadband and narrowband radiated emissions per the ESA methods referenced in paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 6.6.2.1. (and 7.10.2.1. if applicable); pass if measured levels do not exceed the reference limits by more than 4 dB (60 per cent).

text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp as ESA – series production conformity for immunity to electromagnetic radiation (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Conformity of production check on a series-produced lamp ESA: expose to radiated field strength up to 80 per cent of the reference limits of paragraph 6.8.2.1. (and 7.18.2.1. if applicable); pass if no degradation of the lamp functions (e.g. stop lamp, position lamp, reversing lamp flicker or loss) observable by the driver or other road users.

text: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp electronics (LED modules on PCB, vehicle wiring connection) – series production conformity for conducted immunity and conducted emission
test_case: Conformity of production check on a series-produced lamp: apply conducted transient disturbances on supply lines up to the levels of paragraph 6.9.1. (and 7.19.1. if applicable) and verify no degradation of immunity related functions; measure conducted emissions and verify they do not exceed the levels of paragraph 6.7.1. (and 7.17.1. if applicable).

text: For the ESA broadband radiated emission reference limits (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation), in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band the limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and associated driver/connector electronics (ESA) of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the ESA broadband method of UN R10 (Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 30-75 MHz with the lamp functions operating; pass if the emissions at every frequency F are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

text: For the ESA broadband radiated emission reference limits (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation), in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band the limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75).
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and associated driver/connector electronics (ESA) of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the ESA broadband method of UN R10 (Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 75-400 MHz with the lamp functions operating; pass if the emissions at every frequency F are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

text: For the ESA broadband radiated emission reference limits (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation), in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit E for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 63 dBµV/m.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and associated driver/connector electronics (ESA) of the rear combination lamp
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per the ESA broadband method of UN R10 (Annex 7) with a 120 kHz bandwidth across 400-1,000 MHz with the lamp functions operating; pass if the emissions are at or below 63 dBµV/m throughout the band.

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation of the ESA in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dB microvolts/m (F in MHz), for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / ESA electronics of the rear combination lamp
test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission test per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, scan 30-75 MHz; pass if all emissions are at or below 52 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation of the ESA in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band shall not exceed the limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dB microvolts/m (F in MHz), for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / ESA electronics of the rear combination lamp
test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission test per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, scan 75-400 MHz; pass if all emissions are at or below 42 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m.

text: When measured according to paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, the narrowband electromagnetic radiation limit of the ESA in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at E = 53 dB microvolts/m, for a 120 kHz bandwidth.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / ESA electronics of the rear combination lamp
test_case: ESA narrowband radiated emission test per paragraph 6.6.2.1. (Annex 8 method), 120 kHz bandwidth, scan 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all emissions are at or below 53 dBµV/m.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
applies_to: EMC test setup for the rear combination lamp (LV-powered ESA: LED modules on PCB, vehicle wiring connection)
test_case: Inspect the ESA test setup: confirm the AN in the LV supply line is a 5 µH / 50 Ω network per Appendix 8 Figure 1 (L1 5 µH, C1 0,1 µF, C2 1 µF, R1 1 kΩ); pass if the network type and component values match.

text: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
applies_to: EMC test setup for the rear combination lamp (artificial network)
test_case: Visual inspection of the test bench: pass if each AN is placed directly on the ground plane with no spacer or insulation.

text: The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
applies_to: EMC test setup for the rear combination lamp (artificial network grounding)
test_case: Inspect the bonding and measure the bonding resistance between the AN ground terminal and the ground plane; pass if a direct low-impedance bond is present.

text: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
applies_to: EMC test setup for the rear combination lamp (AN measurement port)
test_case: Inspect the AN measurement ports during the test: pass if each port is connected to the 50 Ω receiver input or to a 50 Ω termination.

text: The AN impedance ZPB shall be as shown in Figure 2 (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz, measured between the terminals P and B (of Figure 1) with a 50 Ω load on the measurement port and with terminals A and B (of Figure 1) short circuited.
applies_to: EMC test setup for the rear combination lamp (AN impedance characteristic)
test_case: Verify the AN with an impedance analyser: short-circuit A to B, apply a 50 Ω load on the measurement port, and sweep ZPB between P and B from 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz; pass if ZPB stays within ± 20 % of the Figure 2 curve.

text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and lamp electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 7 / CISPR 25 radiated broadband emission test on the lamp ESA; pass if the test setup and procedure conform to CISPR 25 except where Annex 7 states otherwise.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (rear position, stop and reversing lamp LED functions)
test_case: Annex 7 test: operate the lamp in normal operation with all lamp functions energised (maximum load) at the nominal supply voltage; pass if the operating mode is verified and recorded throughout the scan.

text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA
test_case: Radiated emission test in an ALSE per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 (or an OATS per paragraph 3.3); pass if the test arrangement conforms to Clause 6.4.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and in this measurement the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
applies_to: Emission test setup for the lamp ESA
test_case: Ambient scan with the ESA switched off, before or after the main test, over 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if the ambient is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits, except for intentional narrowband transmissions.

text: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA radiated broadband emissions
test_case: ALSE or OATS radiated emission scan from 30 to 1,000 MHz; pass if broadband emissions stay below the paragraph 6.5 limits over the whole range.

text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the quasi-peak limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Emission measurement of the lamp ESA
test_case: Check the test report: if a peak detector is used, the 20 dB CISPR 12 correction factor is applied; pass if the corrected results are below the limits.

text: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 (spectrum analyser, 30 to 1,000 MHz: peak RBW at -3 dB 100/120 kHz, minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz; quasi-peak RBW at -6 dB 120 kHz, minimum scan time 20 s/MHz) and Table 2 (scanning receiver, 30 to 1,000 MHz: BW at -6 dB 120 kHz, peak maximum step size 60 kHz and minimum dwell time 5 ms; quasi-peak maximum step size 60 kHz and minimum dwell time 1 s).
applies_to: Emission measurement equipment for the lamp ESA
test_case: Verify the instrument settings against Table 1/Table 2; pass if the RBW/BW, scan time, step size and dwell time comply.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, and if using FFT-based instruments the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
applies_to: Emission measurement equipment for the lamp ESA
test_case: If an FFT receiver is used, verify continuous real-time recording and a measurement time of at least 1 s per analysis band.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
applies_to: Emission measurement equipment for the lamp ESA
test_case: Check the analyser settings: pass if VBW is at least 3 × RBW during peak measurements.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
applies_to: Lamp ESA test harness arrangement
test_case: Verify the test setup: pass if the LV harness of the lamp is placed on the antenna side.

text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
applies_to: Lamp ESA test setup (antenna/harness alignment)
test_case: Measure the antenna position: pass if the antenna phase centre is aligned with the centre of the longitudinal harness section.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission evaluation
test_case: For any exceedance, repeat the measurement with the ESA off or compare it with the ambient scan; pass if the cause (ESA or background) is identified and documented.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission results evaluation
test_case: Measure with horizontal and vertical antenna polarization; for each of the 14 bands take the maximum reading relative to the limit; pass if every characteristic reading is below the limit.

text: Unless otherwise stated in Annex 8, the test measuring the narrowband electromagnetic emissions radiated by the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB and driver/connector electronics (ESA)
test_case: Annex 8 / CISPR 25 radiated narrowband emission test on the lamp ESA; pass if test set-up and procedure conform to CISPR 25 where Annex 8 is silent.

text: During the test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
applies_to: Lamp ESA (rear position, stop and reversing LED functions)
test_case: Annex 8 test with all lamp functions energised at nominal supply in normal operation, preferably maximum load (all LED functions on); pass if operating state is documented and maintained during the test.

text: The test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission test set-up
test_case: Radiated narrowband emission test in absorber lined shielded enclosure per CISPR 25 para 6.4; pass if set-up conforms.

text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission test site
test_case: If OATS is used, verify site compliance with CISPR 16-1-4 (Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7); pass if site validation is valid.

text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission test (ambient check)
test_case: Ambient scan with ESA switched off before or after the main test; pass if ambient scan is recorded.

text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission test (ambient check)
test_case: Compare ambient scan 30–1,000 MHz with para 6.6.2.1 limits; pass if ambient ≥ 6 dB below limits except intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

text: The narrowband radiated emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
applies_to: Lamp ESA radiated narrowband emissions
test_case: Scan 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions are below the para 6.6.2.1 limits across the whole range.

text: Narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify receiver/analyser detector set to average; pass if all reported data are average-detector readings.

text: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Check instrument type and settings against Tables 1 and 2 of Annex 8; pass if conforming.

text: When a spectrum analyser is used with average detector in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation (spectrum analyser)
test_case: Verify analyser settings: RBW 100/120 kHz (-3 dB), scan time ≥ 100 ms/MHz; pass if met.

text: When a scanning receiver is used with average detector in the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation (scanning receiver)
test_case: Verify receiver settings: BW 120 kHz (-6 dB), step ≤ 60 kHz, dwell ≥ 5 ms; pass if met.

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation (spectrum analyser)
test_case: Check VBW ≥ 3 × RBW for any peak measurement; pass if met.

text: Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments used for conformity measurements shall meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation
test_case: Verify instrument compliance/calibration to CISPR 16-1-1; pass if documented.

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation (FFT-based)
test_case: Verify FFT instrument operates gapless (real-time) during measurement time; pass if confirmed.

text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission measurement instrumentation (FFT-based)
test_case: Check FFT measurement time ≥ 1 s per analysis band in real-time mode; pass if met.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
applies_to: Lamp ESA radiated narrowband emissions
test_case: For any exceedance in 30–1,000 MHz, perform ambient/ESA-off comparison and broadband/narrowband discrimination; pass if exceedance is attributed correctly and ESA narrowband emissions are within limits.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
applies_to: Lamp ESA emission test evaluation
test_case: Measure in horizontal and vertical antenna polarisation; for each of the 14 bands take the maximum reading relative to limit as characteristic reading; pass if all characteristic readings are below the limit.

text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11. Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (LED modules on PCB, connector/driver electronics)
test_case: Review the test plan and reports: the chosen ISO 11452-2/-3/-4/-5/-11 methods together cover 20 to 6,000 MHz without gaps; pass if full range covered.

text: The test conditions for ESA immunity testing shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test setup
test_case: Audit the test setup (temperature, supply voltage, ground plane, etc.) against ISO 11452-1; pass if conformant.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: During immunity test, power the lamp and activate the rear position, stop and reversing functions in normal operation; verify operating state is monitored throughout exposure.

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9 unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test arrangement
test_case: Inspect the test arrangement against Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part; pass if arrangement conforms.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test support equipment
test_case: Verify calibration records/setup photos show no ESA support equipment present during field calibration.

text: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA test support equipment
test_case: Measure distance of any equipment from the reference point during calibration; pass if all ≥ 1 m.

text: The test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test equipment
test_case: Compare test signal chain and layout during test with calibration configuration; pass if identical.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit, the interconnecting cables should ideally be the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle; if these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp wiring harness / vehicle wiring connection to PCB
test_case: Check the test harness: vehicle-intended harness used, or harness length between ECU and AN per applicable ISO 11452 part; loads terminated realistically.

text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity
test_case: Sweep 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes; pass if lamp functions show no degradation.

text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify signal generator settings: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth over 20–400 MHz.

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify generator settings: pulse Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs over 2,700–3,100 MHz.

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test signal
test_case: Verify generator settings: pulse Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs over 380–2,700 MHz and 3,100–6,000 MHz.

text: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test
test_case: Check test plan step size and dwell time against ISO 11452-1 values.

text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in Annex 9, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA immunity test evaluation
test_case: On any failure, check field monitoring/forward power and setup to confirm failure occurred under the specified field conditions.

text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – absorber chamber test
test_case: ISO 11452-2 absorber chamber: verify field calibration by substitution method; lamp functions unaffected at required field strength.

text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – absorber chamber test
test_case: Verify antenna set in vertical polarization during ISO 11452-2 test.

text: TEM cell testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – TEM cell test
test_case: If used, perform TEM cell test per ISO 11452-3 with maximum field coupling to ESA or harness; lamp functions unaffected.

text: Bulk current injection testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with either the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA; as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA and its wiring harness – BCI test
test_case: Perform BCI per ISO 11452-4 (probe at 150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed loop) or ISO 11451-4 in vehicle (150 mm); lamp functions unaffected.

text: Stripline testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA wiring harness – stripline test
test_case: If used, expose harness in stripline per ISO 11452-5 at specified field strengths; lamp functions unaffected.

text: Reverberation chamber testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – reverberation chamber test
test_case: If used, perform reverberation chamber test per ISO 11452-11; lamp functions unaffected.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp ESA – reverberation chamber test setup
test_case: Inspect reverberation chamber setup: ESA and harness arranged on ground plane.

text: The ESA shall be immune to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply, and conducted transients from the ESA to the vehicle power supply shall be limited.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (ESA) connected to vehicle power supply
test_case: Annex 10 test method: immunity per paragraph 2 and emission per paragraph 3; ESA meets immunity and emission limits of UN R10.

text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / vehicle wiring connection (12/24 V supply lines)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b applied to supply and operationally connected lines; lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) meet the functional status required by UN R10 immunity criteria.

text: The starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines; ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / vehicle wiring connection (12/24 V supply lines)
test_case: ISO 16750-2 starting profile applied to supply and operationally connected lines (unless ESA exclusively for electric vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor); lamp functions meet required functional status.

text: Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB / lamp electronics (12/24 V supply lines)
test_case: ISO 7637-2 conducted transient emission measurement on supply and operationally connected lines while switching lamp functions; emitted transients within UN R10 limits.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
applies_to: Housing / outer lens marking area
test_case: Design review and visual inspection of drawings and samples: a marking area is provided that is large enough to hold the approval marking and all markings of 3.3.3.2 to 3.3.3.6.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
applies_to: All markings on lamp and components
test_case: Visual legibility check, then an indelibility test (e.g. rubbing with a water- or solvent-soaked cloth). Pass if the markings remain legible and intact.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark per the Annex 7 arrangement. Pass if a ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking against the approval documents. Pass if the circled "E" is present with the correct country number.

text: The approval marking shall include the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection of the marking layout per Annex 7. Pass if the sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.

text: The approval marking shall include the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
applies_to: Approval marking (rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector functions)
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the function symbols (e.g. R, S1/S2, AR, retro-reflector class) are present for all approved functions.

text: The approval marking shall include the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
applies_to: Approval marking
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if "148R" is followed by the correct two-digit series of amendments.

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
applies_to: Approval marking of handed (LH/RH) rear lamp
test_case: Check whether the lamp is handed. If it is, a visual inspection must show a horizontal arrow indicating the mounting position.

text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: (a) Direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12; (b) Front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps; (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
applies_to: Mounting arrow for rear position lamp / reversing lamp
test_case: Visual inspection with the lamp positioned as fitted on the vehicle. Pass if the arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

text: If applicable, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.: (a) the additional letter "D" shall be marked on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps; (b) the additional letter "Y" shall be marked on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
applies_to: Function symbols (stop lamp, rear position lamp)
test_case: Check the system configuration in the approval documents. Pass if "D" or "Y" appears immediately to the right of the function symbol where applicable.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
applies_to: Approval marking of lamps with reduced light distribution
test_case: If reduced light distribution is declared, a visual inspection must show the downward vertical arrow on a horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the approval marking is present.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the applicant's trade name or mark is present.

text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed; (b) in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (light source marking)
test_case: Determine the light source type. If replaceable, a visual inspection must show the light source category marking(s), plus the LED substitute categories where approved.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with: (a) an electronic light source control gear; and/or (b) a variable luminous intensity control; and/or (c) a secondary operating mode; and/or (d) non-replaceable light sources.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp with LED modules
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range is marked on the lamp.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
applies_to: LED modules (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection of each module. Pass if the trade name or mark is present.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., and, in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters. The approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp in which the module is used, but both marks shall be from the same applicant.
applies_to: LED modules (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if "MD" is followed by the uncircled approval mark, distinct suffixes are used for non-identical modules, and the mark is from the same applicant as the lamp.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
applies_to: LED modules (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the rated voltage or voltage range is marked on the module.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii) and the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (if replaceable modules used)
test_case: Visual inspection of the lamp. Pass if the module ID code and the rated voltage or range are both marked on the lamp.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
applies_to: External LED driver / control gear (if any)
test_case: If the control gear is external to the lamp body, a visual inspection must show its identification number and the manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
applies_to: Approval marking location (outer lens / housing)
test_case: Design review of the assembly. Pass if the marked part cannot be separated from the light-emitting transparent part.

text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
applies_to: Approval marking location
test_case: Vehicle installation check. Pass if the marking is visible with the lamp fitted, or with the tailgate, boot lid or door opened.

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
applies_to: Outer lens and housing
test_case: If the lens is detachable, a visual inspection must show the approval marking on both the lens and the housing.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
applies_to: Housing / main body under shared outer lens
test_case: Visual inspection of each main body. Pass if it bears only its own functions' approval marking.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if all listed markings are on the lamp itself.

text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
applies_to: LED modules (if replaceable)
test_case: Visual inspection. Pass if the module markings are on the module itself.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bear a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number, this marking shall be visible after their installation.
applies_to: Single approval mark on rear combination lamp
test_case: Vehicle installation check. Pass if the single approval mark is visible with the lamp installed.

text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps bear a single approval mark, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
applies_to: Single approval mark location / outer lens
test_case: Design and disassembly review. Pass if every light-transmitting part is removable only together with the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
applies_to: Single approval mark
test_case: Measure the mark components against the minimum sizes in the pertinent UN Regulations. Pass if no component is smaller than the smallest required minimum.

text: The conformity of production procedures for the lamps shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements set forth in paragraph 6.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector): production conformity
test_case: Audit of the manufacturer's conformity of production system and records against the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3) and paragraph 6 of UN R148. Pass if the procedures are in place and sampled production lamps meet the paragraph 6 requirements.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply. The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where their verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) and its installation on the M1 vehicle
test_case: Document and check review at lamp type approval: list the applicable UN R48 (series in force at application) section 5 and 6 installation requirements for each function on M1 (e.g. geometric visibility angles, mounting height/width position, orientation, colour, number of lamps). Verify by drawing and geometric evaluation, plus photometric/visibility checks where feasible. Pass: every requirement whose verification is feasible at lamp approval is shown to be met.

text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions; housing, lens, LED modules on PCB, fasteners/clips, seal)
test_case: Design review and vibration/durability testing representative of normal vehicle use (e.g. per manufacturer vibration profile), followed by functional check and re-measurement of photometric and colorimetric characteristics; pass if all functions operate satisfactorily and remain within the limits prescribed by UN R148, with no loosening, cracking or detachment of parts.

text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" is applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (if approved as an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D")
test_case: Document review of approval documentation and markings: if the "D" marking is used, check it is applied only to a rear position lamp or stop lamp function (not the reversing lamp or retro-reflector) and that the assembly consists of two independent lamps; pass if the marking and lamp types conform.

text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" is applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions (if approved as an interdependent lamp system marked "Y")
test_case: Document review of approval documentation and markings: if the "Y" marking is used, check it is applied only to rear position lamp or stop lamp interdependent lamps (not the reversing lamp or retro-reflector); pass if the marking and lamp types conform.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp function groups (if reciprocally incorporated); LED modules on PCB
test_case: Design review of the optical/electrical architecture: confirm the rear position and stop functions use separate light sources (separate LED groups/circuits), or that the vehicle has a lamp failure tell-tale. Pass if (a) or (b) is met and the choice is documented.

text: If the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, it shall incorporate only one logo, and all requirements of this Regulation for the specific function shall be fulfilled.
applies_to: Outer lens; Reflector; Rear position lamp function
test_case: Inspect the drawings and sample: confirm no more than one logo per lamp function. Repeat the full photometric and colorimetric tests for that function with the logo present. Pass if all function requirements are met.

text: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed as a logo incorporated in the lamp, and this shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).
applies_to: Outer lens; Reflector (logo content)
test_case: Check the logo artwork against the vehicle or body manufacturer brand, and confirm the applicant's statement exists. Pass if only that brand logo is used.

text: The enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
applies_to: Outer lens; Reflector (logo area)
test_case: Measure the projected enclosed logo area in the direction of the reference axis, from CAD or an orthogonal projection. Pass if the area is ≤ 100 cm2.

text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
applies_to: Stop lamp and reversing lamp function groups; Outer lens
test_case: Visual and drawing inspection of the stop and reversing lamp apparent surfaces and optics. Pass if no logo is present.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, LED wiring/circuit design)
test_case: Review the PCB schematic and LED wiring; open-circuit each LED in turn and confirm whether the whole group extinguishes. Any group that extinguishes together is treated as one light source for the failure assessment of paragraph 4.6.1.2. Pass if the light-source grouping is correctly identified and documented.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3, and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
applies_to: Rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp functions (LED modules on PCB, driver/connector electronics)
test_case: For each light source (or group per 4.6.1.1), simulate failure and measure photometry at the Annex 3 standard light distribution points. Pass under option (a) if all points meet the minimum values with one source failed and no maximum is exceeded with all sources lit. Pass under option (b) if the lamp outputs a failure signal suitable for tell-tale activation per the cited UN R48 paragraphs and the communication form carries the restriction note.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of: (a) a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1; (b) a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1; (c) a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1; (d) a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3; (e) a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a; (f) a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
applies_to: Rear position lamp and stop lamp functions, if of variable-intensity category R2/S2/S4 (intensity control electronics on PCB)
test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control (e.g. open or short the control input, disable the driver control) and measure photometry per Annex 3. Pass if the lamp automatically reverts to the steady luminous intensity requirements of the respective category (R1 for R2, S1 for S2, S3 for S4).

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with: replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
applies_to: Rear combination lamp light sources (LED modules on PCB) for rear position, stop and reversing functions
test_case: Design review and inspection of the lamp: confirm that every light source is a UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable light source without use restriction, a light source module or a non-replaceable light source. Pass if no other type of light source is fitted.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
applies_to: LED modules, PCB and driver electronics of the rear combination lamp
test_case: EMC testing of radiated and conducted (power line) emissions of the lamp, for example per UN R10 at vehicle or ESA level. Pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electric/electronic systems occurs and emissions are within the applicable limits.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source modules and housing interface
test_case: Attempt to fit the module in all alternative positions and orientations. Pass if the module can only be fitted in the designated correct position.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source modules and fastening
test_case: Attempt to remove the module by hand without tools. Pass if removal is only possible with the use of tool(s).

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source modules
test_case: Inspect the design and attempt to access or modify the internal components of the module. Pass if the module cannot be tampered with without evident damage.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source modules and module holders in the housing (rear position, stop and reversing functions)
test_case: Attempt, with and without tools, to fit UN approved light sources and the other modules of the same housing into each module position. Pass if no interchange is possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
applies_to: Replaceable LED light source modules; photometry of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps
test_case: Replace the module with another sample bearing the same identification code, then repeat the photometric and colour measurements per UN R148. Pass if all photometric requirements are still met.
