test_case: Installation check / CAD visibility analysis: observe apparent surface from infinity across the required angles of geometric visibility for each function; pass if no vehicle part obstructs light propagation, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

text: If geometric visibility measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
applies_to: Geometric visibility verification of the rear combination lamp functions
test_case: Review measurement procedure: when measuring at finite distance, verify the observation direction is shifted parallel; pass if the method gives accuracy equivalent to observation from infinity.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector as installed on vehicle
test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed lamp with masking replicating the hidden areas; pass if the unobstructed part meets the photometric values of the device approval regulation.

text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp functions mounted less than 750 mm above the ground
test_case: Measure mounting height per para. 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify photometric field of measurement of the installed unit down to at least 5° below horizontal meets requirements.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
applies_to: Any rear lamp function realised as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. body and tailgate parts)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps of the system simultaneously and check geometric visibility angles; pass if the combined system meets the required angles.

text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
applies_to: LED modules on PCB (light source for rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions)
test_case: Document review: check the component type approval communication sheet of the lamp. If the LED module is non-replaceable, pass only if the sheet states that it is non-replaceable. If no such statement exists, verify by inspection that the LED module is replaceable.

text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp: rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector functions
test_case: Document review: check for a valid type approval under the corresponding device Regulation (e.g. UN R148 for rear position, stop and reversing lamps; UN R150 for the retro-reflector) for each function. Check the approval markings on the lamp. Pass if every installed function is covered by a valid approval.

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp light-signalling functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp) if a manufacturer logo is incorporated
test_case: Inspect the lamp design for an incorporated manufacturer logo. If a logo is present, check for a UN R148 type approval covering the lamp with the logo and the corresponding approval marking. Pass if a valid UN R148 approval exists.

text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only. This requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp light sources (LED modules on PCB) for rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions
test_case: Document and visual inspection: compare the light source categories in the lamp approval (R37/R99/R128) with the light sources fitted. Pass if every fitted replaceable light source is approved in the approved category. The LED modules are exempt unless the applicable Regulation requires them to be approved; if it does, pass only if the module bears that approval.

text: A device type approved according to any preceding series of amendments to UN Regulations Nos. 148 and/or 149 and/or 150 is deemed equivalent to one approved according to the latest series of amendments to the pertinent UN Regulations Nos. 148 and/or 149 and/or 150 when the change indexes (defined in paragraph 2.1.6.) related to each individual lamp (function) do not differ. In this case, such a device may be fitted on the vehicle to be type approved without any update of the device type approval documents and device markings.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp device approval and markings (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector functions)
test_case: Document and marking review: compare the change index (paragraph 2.1.6.) of each individual lamp function in the existing UN R148/R149/R150 device approval with the latest series of amendments. Pass if the change indexes do not differ for every function; the device may then be fitted without updating approval documents or markings. Otherwise, the device approval and markings must be updated.

text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – presence on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle; pass if present.

text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – number of devices
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count reversing lamp devices on the M1 vehicle; pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – component approval
test_case: Document and marking check: verify the lamp carries a valid UN R23 (00 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) approval mark for the reversing function; pass if approval is present and valid.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – mounting height on vehicle
test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle on substantially horizontal ground the height of the illuminating surface edges of the reversing lamp; pass if lowest point ≥ 250 mm and highest point ≤ 1,200 mm above ground.

text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – longitudinal position on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle; pass if rear-mounted.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – geometric visibility; outer lens
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle per paragraph 2.10.7: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over α = +15°/−5° and β = ±45° (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices); pass if visibility ensured over the whole field.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Reversing lamp (function group) – orientation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the reversing lamp is directed rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / vehicle wiring and PCB
test_case: Functional vehicle test: engage reverse gear with propulsion system operable; pass if lamp switches ON only under both conditions.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – electrical connection / vehicle wiring and PCB
test_case: Functional vehicle test: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion system off; also attempt activation with each condition unmet; pass if lamp is OFF in all cases.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation; otherwise the tell-tale is optional.
applies_to: Reversing lamp – failure tell-tale / LED module electronics
test_case: Check component regulation (UN R23/R148) for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale activates; pass if tell-tale indicates failure.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2 category device)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify presence of S1 or S2 category stop lamps on the vehicle; pass if present.

text: The number of stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (vehicle installation)
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count installed stop lamp devices by category; pass if two S1/S2 devices and one S3/S4 device are fitted.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Stop lamp function / rear combination lamp
test_case: Document and marking check: verify approval mark and certificate under UN R7 02 series or later, or UN R148 00 series or later; pass if valid approval present.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) lateral mounting position
test_case: Measure on vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) mounting height
test_case: Measure on unladen vehicle per para. 5.8.1 the height of the apparent surface above ground; pass if 350 mm ≤ height ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justification applies and no optional lamps).

text: The horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface of a S3 or S4 category device shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) height relative to S3/S4 stop lamp
test_case: Measure on vehicle the height of the upper edge of the S1/S2 apparent surface and lower edge of the S3/S4 apparent surface; pass if the S3/S4 lower edge is higher.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the position in length shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) longitudinal position
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the stop lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) geometric visibility, outer lens/apparent surface
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: verify unobstructed apparent surface over 45° outward and 45° inward (or 20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility achieved.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Stop lamp function (S1/S2) geometric visibility, outer lens/apparent surface
test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle/CAD: verify unobstructed apparent surface 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visibility achieved.

text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Stop lamp function orientation
test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: pass if the reference axis of the stop lamp points rearward.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
applies_to: Stop lamp function electrical connection, LED modules/PCB, vehicle wiring
test_case: Functional test on vehicle: apply brake signal per UN R13/R13-H; pass if all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
applies_to: Stop lamp function electrical connection
test_case: Functional test: with propulsion start/stop device in off position, operating stop lamps is not required; verify stop lamps operate in all other positions when brake signal applied.

text: A tell-tale for the stop lamp is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
applies_to: Stop lamp function, failure tell-tale / LED module electronics
test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) approval for failure-indication requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and pass if failure tell-tale is activated.

text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the rear position lamp function is fitted and its approval marking shows category R, R1 or R2; pass if present.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group)
test_case: Vehicle inspection and approval document check: count the rear position lamps and check approval markings and certificates; pass if exactly two lamps are fitted, each approved to UN R7 02+ or UN R148 00+.

text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle. This condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group) installation on vehicle
test_case: Measure on the vehicle, along the reference axis, the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group) installation on vehicle
test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground with the vehicle on a horizontal surface according to paragraph 5.8.1; pass if lowest edge ≥ 350 mm and highest edge ≤ 1,500 mm (≤ 2,100 mm only where bodywork justifies it and no optional lamps are fitted).

text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group) installation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), outer lens, housing installation
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards (20° under the H plane if mounted below 750 mm) and 80° outwards; pass if visible throughout.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), outer lens, housing installation
test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane; and a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group) installation on vehicle (alternative visibility with rear side-marker lamp)
test_case: If this alternative is chosen, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted, then check unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if below 750 mm) and 15° up/down (5° down if below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

text: To be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres; the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), outer lens, retro-reflector
test_case: At each limit direction of the geometric visibility angles, measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface excluding non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: The orientation of the rear position lamp shall be rearwards.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group) installation on vehicle
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards; pass if oriented rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), PCB, vehicle wiring connection
test_case: Functional check on vehicle per paragraph 5.11: verify the rear position lamps switch ON/OFF together with the front position lamps and registration plate lamp; pass if compliant.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), vehicle tell-tale
test_case: Vehicle functional check: switch on position lamps and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates, shared with the front position lamps; pass if present and combined.

text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
applies_to: Rear position lamp (function group), LED modules, PCB, vehicle tell-tale
test_case: Check component regulation (UN R7/R148) approval for failure-monitoring requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify failure tell-tale activates; pass if activated.

text: Rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (vehicle installation)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify presence of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector
test_case: Check vehicle has two retro-reflectors bearing valid R3 (02 series or later) Class IA/IB or R150 (00 series or later) approval markings; pass if both approved.

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector / additional retro-reflecting devices
test_case: Visual/photometric review of installation: pass if any additional retro-reflecting devices do not obscure or impair mandatory lamps.

text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (installation position)
test_case: Measure lateral distance from outermost point of illuminating surface to extreme outer edge of vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear retro-reflectors in the direction of the reference axes has no special requirement.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (installation position)
test_case: Documentation check: no minimum separation verification required for M1 vehicle.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (installation height)
test_case: Measure height of illuminating surface above ground on unladen vehicle per para 5.8; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 900 mm (≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, ≤ 1,500 mm if bodywork justification applies).

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (installation position)
test_case: Vehicle inspection: pass if retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be: horizontal angle 30° inwards and outwards; vertical angle 10° above and below horizontal; however, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (geometric visibility)
test_case: Geometric visibility check (CAD/vehicle): verify unobstructed illuminating surface over ±30° horizontal and +10°/−10° vertical (−5° downward if mounted below 750 mm); pass if no obstruction.

text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
applies_to: Rear retro-reflector (orientation)
test_case: Inspect installation: pass if reference axis points rearwards parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis.

text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installation on the vehicle (rear position, stop and reversing lamps, rear retro-reflector), conformity of production
test_case: Conformity of production check: inspect production vehicles to confirm the installed rear combination lamp functions meet the installation requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R48 as approved (number, position, geometric visibility, orientation, electrical connections, tell-tales). Pass if no deviation from the approved type is found.

text: For the visibility check of paragraph 5.10.4. (no red light visible to the front, no white light visible to the rear except from the reversing lamp), the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground, and in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp installed on vehicle: red rear position and stop lamp functions (visibility to the front) and white reversing lamp / white light emitted from lens (visibility to the rear)
test_case: Installation check on vehicle per paragraph 5.10.4. and Annex 4: on vehicle standing on horizontal ground, define the zones at the front and rear (heights 1 m to 2.2 m, lateral limits at 15° outwards through the overall-width contact points: foremost point for the forward plane, rearmost point for the rearward plane). With all lamp functions on, scan zone 1 (front) and zone 2 (rear) by eye. Pass: no red light from the rear lamp is directly visible in the front zone, and no white light other than the reversing lamp is directly visible in the rear zone.

text: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Installation of rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector on the vehicle
test_case: COP check on vehicle: measure lamp positions in width, height and length per paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; the measurement is performed and recorded for each lamp.

text: The values measured for the distances of the lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Installation of rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector on the vehicle
test_case: Compare measured width/height/length distances with the individual installation specifications for rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector; pass if all are within limits.

text: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
applies_to: Geometric visibility of rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector as installed
test_case: COP check per paragraph 2.10.7.: measure horizontal and vertical visibility angles of each installed lamp; pass if the individual specified angles are met, allowing ±3º tolerance on angle limits.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
applies_to: Red rear position/stop lamp light and white reversing lamp light as installed
test_case: COP check per paragraph 5.10.: verify no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and white light towards the rear is only from permitted lamps (reversing lamp); pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
applies_to: Electrical connection of rear position, stop and reversing lamp LED modules/PCB to vehicle wiring
test_case: COP check: switch on each lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) via vehicle controls; each function lights up.

text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
applies_to: Rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and associated tell-tales
test_case: Functional check of switching and electrical connection conditions per paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and individual lamp specifications (e.g. stop lamp on brake application, reversing lamp with reverse gear, rear position lamp with position lamps); pass if all conditions are met.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, and these shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
applies_to: Rear combination lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing lamps, retro-reflector), outer lens colour and approval markings
test_case: Visual inspection of installed lamps and markings: verify presence, number, colour (red/white), arrangement and category; pass if paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual lamp specifications are fulfilled.
